ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the clock edge used by the bus_access process and is forwarded to instantiated neoTRNG and FIFO. Drives timing for sequential assignments (bus responses, enable and fifo_clr updates).
ports.evidence: process bus_access uses rising_edge(clk_i); clk_i port map to neoTRNG_inst and rnd_pool_fifo_inst.

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Provides active-low reset for the bus_access process and is forwarded to instantiated modules. Drives the reset branch that clears enable and fifo_clr and sets bus_rsp_o to termination value.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then ... in bus_access; rstn_i port map to neoTRNG_inst and rnd_pool_fifo_inst.

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.functionality: Encapsulates individual bus request fields used by this entity; individual subfields drive control and data paths in the bus_access process. The aggregate record itself is not used as a single value.
role: source of bus fields (subfields used individually)
ports.evidence: Fields of bus_req_i are referenced (stb, rw, addr, data) but the aggregate bus_req_i is not used as a whole.

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.functionality: Provides address bit 2 used to select control vs data read paths and to qualify FIFO read; its bit(2) decides which bus_rsp_o.data fields are driven and participates in fifo.re condition.
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.addr(2) = '0') then ...; fifo.re uses bus_req_i.addr(2) in its conditional assignment.

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Carries write data used to update internal control bits on a bus write; specific indexed bits are captured into enable and fifo_clr when a write occurs.
ports.evidence: enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c); fifo_clr <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_fifo_clr_c) inside write branch.

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Declared part of the bus_req_t bundle but not referenced anywhere in this source.
ports.evidence: No occurrence of bus_req_i.ben in source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Indicates a valid bus transaction; it is used to assert ack, to gate read/write handling inside the clocked bus_access process, and as a term in the fifo.re combinational expression.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb; outer if (bus_req_i.stb = '1') then ...; fifo.re conditional includes bus_req_i.stb.

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Selects write path (when '1') to update enable and fifo_clr or read path (when '0') to drive bus_rsp_o.data, and it participates in fifo.re generation for reads.
ports.evidence: if (bus_req_i.rw = '1') then ... else ...; fifo.re uses (bus_req_i.rw = '0') in its expression.

ports.name: bus_req_i.src
ports.functionality: Declared in the bus_req_t bundle but not referenced in this source.
ports.evidence: No occurrence of bus_req_i.src in source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.priv
ports.functionality: Declared but not used in this entity's source.
ports.evidence: No occurrence of bus_req_i.priv in source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.debug
ports.functionality: Declared in bus_req_t but not referenced in this source.
ports.evidence: No occurrence of bus_req_i.debug in source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.amo
ports.functionality: Part of the bus request bundle but not used here.
ports.evidence: No occurrence of bus_req_i.amo in source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.amoop
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced in this entity's source.
ports.evidence: No occurrence of bus_req_i.amoop in source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.lock
ports.functionality: Declared in bundle but not used in this source.
ports.evidence: No occurrence of bus_req_i.lock in source.

ports.name: bus_req_i.fence
ports.functionality: Part of bus_req_t but not referenced in this entity.
ports.evidence: No occurrence of bus_req_i.fence in source.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Provides the response bundle (ack, err, data) to the bus; the bundle is assigned in reset and updated on clock edges from internal signals and constants.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o <= rsp_terminate_c in reset branch; fields assigned in rising_edge(clk_i) inside bus_access.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: Reports an acknowledge to the bus; on clock it is driven from bus_req_i.stb and is also part of the reset assignment of the full response bundle.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.ack <= bus_req_i.stb in rising_edge(clk_i); bus_rsp_o set in reset branch.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Provides the error bit in the bus response; it is set to '0' every clock in the bus_access process and otherwise initialized via the reset assignment of the response bundle.
ports.evidence: bus_rsp_o.err <= '0' in rising_edge(clk_i); bus_rsp_o <= rsp_terminate_c on reset.

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Delivers control bits, FIFO status and FIFO-read data to the bus; different bit ranges are assigned from enable, constants, fifo.avail and fifo.rdata depending on address and fifo.avail.
ports.evidence: Assignments in bus_access: bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_en_c)<=enable; bus_rsp_o.data(ctrl_avail_c)<=fifo.avail; data MSB:LSB <= fifo.rdata or zero; guarded by bus_req_i.addr and stb/rw.

ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides rising_edge timing for the entity's clocked processes and is forwarded to each neoTRNG_cell instance's clk_i port.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) in debiasing and sampling_control; port map clk_i => clk_i in neoTRNG_cell_inst (generate)

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Asynchronous active-low reset for the clocked processes and is forwarded to each neoTRNG_cell instance's rstn_i port.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') branches in debiasing and sampling_control; port map rstn_i => rstn_i in neoTRNG_cell_inst (generate)

ports.name: enable_i
ports.functionality: Is captured into sample_en at the clock edge to enable sampling; not used elsewhere directly.
ports.evidence: sample_en <= enable_i on rising_edge(clk_i) in sampling_control process

ports.name: valid_o
ports.functionality: Reports the MSB of sample_cnt as a ready/valid flag indicating a full sample is available on data_o.
ports.evidence: valid_o <= sample_cnt(sample_cnt'left) concurrent assignment in architecture

ports.name: data_o
ports.functionality: Conveys the 8-bit sampled value from the internal shift register sample_sreg to the entity output.
ports.evidence: data_o <= sample_sreg concurrent assignment

ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the rising-edge timing used by processes that capture sreg, sync, and inv_out (simulation mode). It clocks en_shift_reg, synchronizer, and the simulation inverter process.
role: timing source for sreg and sync
timing source for inv_out in SIM_MODE
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) used in en_shift_reg, synchronizer, and inverter_sim_ff processes (concurrent processes).

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: When asserted low it forces sreg and sync to zeros by selecting the reset assignments in their processes; it controls the reset branches in en_shift_reg and synchronizer.
role: overrides sreg and sync values on reset
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then sreg <= (others => '0') and sync <= (others => '0') in their respective processes.

ports.name: en_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the bit shifted into sreg and also governs each latch entry (forces latch(i) to '0' when low); used by en_shift_reg and latch conditional assignment.
ports.evidence: sreg <= ... & en_i in en_shift_reg; latch(i) <= '0' when (en_i = '0') else ... in ring_osc_gen.

ports.name: en_o
ports.functionality: Continuously reports the most-significant bit of sreg to the outside world; assigned from sreg(sreg'left).
ports.evidence: concurrent assignment en_o <= sreg(sreg'left).

ports.name: rnd_o
ports.functionality: Exports the synchronized ring-oscillator sample sync(1) as the entity's random output; assigned continuously from sync(1).
ports.evidence: concurrent assignment rnd_o <= sync(1).

signals.name: enable
signals.functionality: Captured on clock from bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c) and cleared on reset; controls neoTRNG enable and participates in fifo.clear combinational condition.
signals.evidence: enable <= '0' on reset; enable <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_en_c) on write; used in fifo.clear concurrent when expression and port map to neoTRNG_inst.

signals.name: fifo_clr
signals.functionality: Captured from bus write bit bus_req_i.data(ctrl_fifo_clr_c) and cleared on reset; combines with enable to drive fifo.clear signal.
signals.evidence: fifo_clr <= '0' on reset; fifo_clr <= bus_req_i.data(ctrl_fifo_clr_c) on write; used in fifo.clear concurrent assignment.

signals.name: fifo
signals.functionality: Record grouping FIFO control and data signals; its individual fields are used to connect the neoTRNG and the FIFO instance and to drive bus responses.
signals.evidence: Individual fifo fields (we,re,clear,wdata,rdata,avail,half,free) are referenced; the aggregate fifo is not assigned as a whole.

signals.name: fifo.we
signals.functionality: Carries the valid pulse from the neoTRNG instance into the FIFO write-enable input, connecting neoTRNG.valid_o to fifo write logic (rnd_pool_fifo_inst.we_i).
signals.evidence: Port map: neoTRNG.valid_o => fifo.we and rnd_pool_fifo_inst.we_i => fifo.we.

signals.name: fifo.re
signals.functionality: Driven combinationally from bus read conditions (bus_req_i.stb, rw='0', addr(2)='1') and forwarded to the FIFO instance re_i to request reads.
signals.evidence: fifo.re <= '1' when (bus_req_i.stb='1') and (bus_req_i.rw='0') and (bus_req_i.addr(2)='1') else '0'; port map to rnd_pool_fifo_inst.re_i.

signals.name: fifo.clear
signals.functionality: Combinationally driven by enable and fifo_clr (asserted when enable='0' or fifo_clr='1') and forwarded to the FIFO clear_i input.
signals.evidence: fifo.clear <= '1' when (enable = '0') or (fifo_clr = '1') else '0'; port map clear_i => fifo.clear.

signals.name: fifo.wdata
signals.functionality: Carries 8-bit random data from neoTRNG.data_o into the FIFO wdata_i input for storage.
signals.evidence: Port map: neoTRNG.data_o => fifo.wdata and rnd_pool_fifo_inst.wdata_i => fifo.wdata.

signals.name: fifo.rdata
signals.functionality: Receives 8-bit read data from the FIFO rdata_o port and supplies those bytes to the bus response data field when a data read is requested.
signals.evidence: rnd_pool_fifo_inst.rdata_o => fifo.rdata (port map); bus_rsp_o.data MSB:LSB <= fifo.rdata when fifo.avail='1'.

signals.name: fifo.avail
signals.functionality: Reflects FIFO availability (data present) from the FIFO instance and is used both to report availability in control bits and to select whether bus read returns zeros or fifo.rdata.
signals.evidence: rnd_pool_fifo_inst.avail_o => fifo.avail (port map); used in if fifo.avail='0' then ... else ... for bus response.

signals.name: fifo.half
signals.functionality: Forwarded from FIFO half_o via port map; declared but not used elsewhere in this entity.
signals.evidence: rnd_pool_fifo_inst.half_o => fifo.half in port map; no other references.

signals.name: fifo.free
signals.functionality: Forwarded from FIFO free_o via port map; available internally but not used by logic in this source.
signals.evidence: rnd_pool_fifo_inst.free_o => fifo.free in port map; no other references.

signals.name: cell_en_in
signals.functionality: Forms each cell's en_i input by taking sample_en for bit 0 and the shifted cell_en_out for higher bits, and feeds neoTRNG_cell instances.
signals.evidence: cell_en_in(0) <= sample_en and cell_en_in(NUM_CELLS-1 downto 1) <= cell_en_out(NUM_CELLS-2 downto 0); port map en_i => cell_en_in(i)

signals.name: cell_en_out
signals.functionality: Is driven by each cell's en_o port and supplies the shifted enable chain and a bit used by debias_state logic.
signals.evidence: port map en_o => cell_en_out(i); cell_en_in slice assignment and debias_state uses cell_en_out(cell_en_out'left) in debiasing

signals.name: cell_rnd
signals.functionality: Is driven from each cell's rnd_o port and supplies bits that are XOR-reduced into the single-cell_sum output.
signals.evidence: port map rnd_o => cell_rnd(i); combine process loops over cell_rnd to compute cell_sum

signals.name: cell_sum
signals.functionality: Is computed as the XOR of all cell_rnd bits in the combine process and supplies a single entropy bit to the debias shift register.
signals.evidence: combine process assigns cell_sum from XOR over cell_rnd; debias_sreg <= debias_sreg(0) & cell_sum in debiasing

signals.name: debias_sreg
signals.functionality: On each clock captures debias_sreg(0) concatenated with cell_sum, provides debias_data and contributes to debias_valid computation.
signals.evidence: debias_sreg <= debias_sreg(0) & cell_sum in debiasing process; debias_valid and debias_data assigned from debias_sreg

signals.name: debias_state
signals.functionality: Toggles each clock and is ANDed with the top bit of cell_en_out to contribute to debias_valid gating.
signals.evidence: debias_state <= (not debias_state) and cell_en_out(cell_en_out'left) in debiasing; debias_valid uses debias_state

signals.name: debias_valid
signals.functionality: Is high when debias_state is set and the two debias_sreg bits differ; it enables sampling updates when asserted.
signals.evidence: debias_valid <= debias_state and (debias_sreg(1) xor debias_sreg(0)); used in sampling_control condiion

signals.name: debias_data
signals.functionality: Carries the current debiased bit (debias_sreg(0)) into the sampling shift logic where it is XORed into the sample register.
signals.evidence: debias_data <= debias_sreg(0); sample_sreg updates use debias_data in sampling_control

signals.name: sample_en
signals.functionality: Captures external enable_i on the clock edge and controls whether sampling counters and shift register are reset or allowed to increment/shift.
signals.evidence: sample_en <= enable_i on rising_edge(clk_i); used in sampling_control if (sample_en = '0'); cell_en_in(0) <= sample_en

signals.name: sample_sreg
signals.functionality: Shifts left each accepted debiased bit, XORing it into the MSB, holds the sampled byte and drives data_o.
signals.evidence: sample_sreg <= sample_sreg(6 downto 0) & (sample_sreg(7) xor debias_data) on rising_edge; data_o <= sample_sreg

signals.name: sample_cnt
signals.functionality: Counts accepted debiased bits by incrementing each time debias_valid is asserted, resets when sample_en is low or MSB reached; its MSB drives valid_o.
signals.evidence: sample_cnt <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(sample_cnt) + 1) when debias_valid; valid_o <= sample_cnt(sample_cnt'left); sample_cnt(sample_cnt'left) used in sampling_control condition

signals.name: sreg
signals.functionality: Shifts in en_i on rising clk and resets to zeros when rstn_i is low; its MSB is reported on en_o and individual bits gate latch updates.
signals.evidence: en_shift_reg process: sreg <= sreg(sreg'left-1 downto 0) & en_i; en_o <= sreg(sreg'left); latch uses sreg(i) in its when condition.

signals.name: latch
signals.functionality: Selects between fixed '0', holding its previous value, or the inverter output per bit based on en_i and sreg(i); its values are supplied to inv_in and to the synchronizer.
signals.evidence: concurrent assignment in generate: latch(i) <= '0' when (en_i='0') else latch(i) when (sreg(i)='0') else inv_out(i); latch is read by inv_in assignments and synchronizer.

signals.name: inv_in
signals.function: rotated latch vector into inverter inputs
signals.functionality: Is driven from latch with a one-position rotation: inv_in(0)<=latch(NUM_INV-1) and inv_in( N-1 downto 1 )<=latch(N-2 downto 0); it supplies inputs to the inverter outputs.
signals.evidence: inv_in(0) <= latch(NUM_INV-1); inv_in(NUM_INV-1 downto 1) <= latch(NUM_INV-2 downto 0); inv_out <= not inv_in used in inverter generation.

signals.name: inv_out
signals.functionality: Produces per-bit inverted inv_in either combinationally (PHY variant) or captured on clk in simulation mode; these outputs are used by latch to form the ring.
signals.evidence: inverter_phy: inv_out(i) <= not inv_in(i); inverter_sim_ff: on rising_edge(clk_i) inv_out(i) <= not inv_in(i); latch reads inv_out(i) in its else branch.

signals.name: sync
signals.functionality: On reset it clears to zeros; on each rising clock it shifts sync(0) into bit1 and captures latch(latch'left) into bit0, and sync(1) is exported as rnd_o.
signals.evidence: synchronizer process: sync <= sync(0) & latch(latch'left) on rising_edge(clk_i); rnd_o <= sync(1).
